title: Disclosure 302-5 Reductions in energy requirements of products
topic: GRI 1: Foundation 2021 specifies the requirements that the organization must comply with to report in accordance
requirements: a. Reductions in energy requirements of sold products and services achieved during the
reporting period, in joules or multiples.
b. Basis for calculating reductions in energy consumption, such as base year or baseline,
including the rationale for choosing it.
c. Standards, methodologies, assumptions, and/or calculation tools used.

guidance: Use-oriented figures can include, for example, the energy requirements of a car or a computer.
Consumption patterns can include, for example, 10 percent less energy use per 100 km
travelled or per time unit (hour, average working day).
